cases.summary: Victim purchased a Rolex Submariner from Instagram shop 'TimeVault Collectibles' (@timevault.dxb, website timevault-dxb.com). Seller used name 'Abu Faisal'. Payment by bank transfer to BRIGHT STAR GENERAL TRADING FZE, IBAN AE47 0331 0000 0234 5678 901 (Gulf Trust Bank). Watch never delivered; a follow-up 'insurance deposit' of AED 1,900 was also demanded but not paid. Bank records show funds withdrawn in cash within 48 hours and AED 6,000 forwarded to a virtual-asset exchange.

Victim purchased a Cartier Tank from Instagram shop 'Prestige Hours' (@prestigehours_uae). Seller identified himself as 'Khalid', contact number +971 52 884 7719. Payment to IBAN AE12 0440 0000 0987 6543 210 (Al Madar Bank), account holder FARID MUSTAFA — a 22-year-old student who, when interviewed, stated he was recruited via a Telegram ad to 'rent' his bank account for AED 500/week. Suspected money mule. Funds cashed out same day.

Victim ordered an Omega Speedmaster via website prestige-hours.com after seeing an Instagram ad. Paid AED 14,300 by transfer to BRIGHT STAR GENERAL TRADING FZE, IBAN AE47 0331 0000 0234 5678 901. After payment, seller requested an additional AED 2,600 'customs clearance deposit'; victim refused and was blocked. Same customs-deposit script as CASE-2026-03310.
